title: Tools and strengths
lead: A selection of what I use to design product end to end: from research to a considered, feasible interface.

items.title: Product & UX design
items.body: From problem to solution: research, information architecture, flows and prototypes I validate before reaching final design.

items.title: UI & visual design
items.body: I turn ideas into clear visual directions, interface systems and brand-aligned assets.

items.title: Front-end & handoff
items.body: A front-end foundation I use to check the feasibility of my designs, speak developers' language and hand off specs that ship without friction.

items.title: Professional strengths
items.body: I work with teams and clients through clear communication, problem-solving, adaptability and a user-centered mindset.
